Question ID: STAT_U01_UA_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.1

A survey records favorite school subject. What type of data is collected?

feedback.text: No numerical quantity is measured.
Only one categorical variable is recorded.
Category responses are valid data.
Favorite subject is a label or group, not a measured amount.

questiontext.text:

feedback.text: A pie chart is for one categorical variable.

feedback.text: Categories remain in the comparison.
Relative frequencies describe data but do not prove cause.

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.2

answer.text: Title, labels, units, scale, and context

feedback.text: These components define what the quantities mean.
